page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9g.64xlarge is a bare-metal instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 256 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system allocates exactly one thread per core, providing dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance features 2304.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 9.0 GB of RAM per core. It bundles eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, delivering a total of 384 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 380 Gbps. No local storage is included with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options.

Given the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, this instance represents a high-tier hardware class optimized for massive parallel processing. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the network configuration. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale machine learning, GPU-accelerated data science, large language model training, and complex scientific simulations.
